event.description: Reduce interleaved model feed-forward width from 16 to 8
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 4,000 parameters at 99.920000%, a +0.920000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 4 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0008, ff_dim=16 at 4,000 parameters and 99.92% official accuracy; the most recent failed result remains attempt-0001, an optimization failure under the superseded separated-token representation with no official score. Hypothesis: interleaved column alignment may permit an 8D nonlinear bottleneck in each block; reducing ff_dim 16->8 is parameterization-preserving compression removing 512 parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=12 because it tests whether half-model-width nonlinear state is viable after square width qualified. Since width 16 transitioned near step 12,000 and checkpointed at 24,000, the stalled-run observation gate moves from step 15,000 to 20,000 to avoid censoring a plausibly delayed transition while retaining a bounded stop.
